participant_eligibility.target: participants capable of solving a 3x3 cube and understanding the move notation used by the instrument
participant_eligibility.minor_participant_handling: requires appropriate adult/school/research supervision and consent/assent procedure before any live collection

session_protocol.repeat_session_same_participant: not allowed in primary dataset unless prospectively designated reliability cohort

post_session_objective: more than 25 percent scored trials missing or timed out
forbidden: exclude because choices disagree with either representation
exclude based on outcome effect direction

primary_analysis.randomization: state-level representation-label swap with participant clustering preserved
primary_analysis.multiple_primary_endpoints: choice contrast is primary; latency is supporting

mechanism_promotion_gate: prospective choice contrast survives frozen analysis
result survives state and participant clustering
effect is not explained by prompt-order or action-order perturbation
reliability replication on fresh packet or fresh participants
no claim that a computational representation is literally the participant internal representation without further evidence
